name: Bay of Storms
summary: Storms churn along Azshara’s eastern cliffs, where sailors face a hazardous coast. Ancient ruins, submerged caverns, and dangerous sea beasts fill the bay.

sections.title: A Tempestuous Coast
sections.body: The Bay of Storms opens onto the Great Sea from Azshara’s eastern coast. Turbulent waters and rocky outcrops shelter dangerous wildlife and ancient aquatic threats. The sunken Temple of Arkkoran lies beneath the waves. Hetaera’s Clutch reefs and Scalebeard’s Cave mark the shore. Casual sailors keep away, leaving the coast to its monsters.

faq.q: Where is the Bay of Storms located?
faq.answer: The Bay of Storms opens onto the Great Sea from Azshara’s eastern edge, off Kalimdor’s coast.

faq.q: What notable landmarks lie within the bay?
aliases: what is in bay of storms
bay of storms points of interest
faq.answer: The Temple of Arkkoran lies in the bay, with Hetaera’s Clutch reef and Scalebeard’s Cave along its shores.

faq.q: Why is the bay dangerous to navigate?
faq.answer: Violent surf, jagged rocks, and hostile aquatic creatures make the bay treacherous for ships. Little coastal civilization is nearby to offer rescue.

angles.text: Fishermen seeking rare deep-water catches work the Bay of Storms’ turbulent waters off Kalimdor’s coast.
